node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=8 order-one quadratic pointwise composition
node.statement: For every h=7 quadratic colored interpolant E=AW^2+BW+C, the pointwise Frobenius equations give A^pE^3+B^pWE^2+C^pW^2E-W^2=A^pA^3L. Comparing top and bottom coefficients forces C/A=(1-rho*c)/(c-1)^2 and the pure HNF equation g(1)=(1-rho*c)^3.
node.notes: Exact assignment-preserving quadratic identity. It adds one HNF parameter equation shared by all collision chambers; incompatibility with the conic and all outer/inner tests remain open.
